preconditions.expression: isinstance(n, int) and n >= 1 and n <= 10**4
preconditions.description: n is an integer between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(graph, list) and len(graph) == n and all(isinstance(neighbors, set) for neighbors in graph)
preconditions.description: graph is a list of length n where each element is a set of integers representing the neighbors of the corresponding node.

postconditions.description: The return value is a non-negative integer representing the count of pairs of nodes at even distance.
